entries.question: Mujhe aaj ka appointment lena hai nephrology me
entries.answer:
KGMU में OPD पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। कृपया ध्यान दें कि OPD का समय सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार को सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक होता है।

आप आज के लिए निम्नलिखित तरीकों से अपॉइंटमेंट ले सकते हैं:

1. **ऑनलाइन (ORS):** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाकर उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य और KGMU का चयन करें।
2. **SMS द्वारा:** `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` लिखकर 8887019134 पर भेजें।
3. **वॉक-इन (Walk-in):** आप सीधे अस्पताल आकर भी पंजीकरण करा सकते हैं। इसके लिए अपना आधार कार्ड और सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर साथ लाएं। वहां OTP के माध्यम से टोकन प्राप्त होगा और ₹50 का शुल्क देकर आप OPD पर्ची प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* OPD पर्ची काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाते हैं।
* यदि आप लखनऊ से बाहर के मरीज हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र साथ जरूर लाएं।
* प्री-बुकिंग करने की सलाह दी जाती है ताकि प्रतीक्षा समय कम हो।

मैं एक AI हूँ, इसलिए मैं सीधे अपॉइंटमेंट बुक नहीं कर सकता। कृपया ऊपर दिए गए आधिकारिक माध्यमों का उपयोग करें। अपना स्वास्थ्य का ध्यान रखें।

entries.question: Can I know the process of Ors system
entries.answer:
To book an appointment via the Online Registration System (ORS), please follow these steps:

1.  **Access the Portal:** Visit the official website at [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
2.  **Login/Register:** 
    *   If you are a new user, register using your mobile number and verify it with the OTP received.
    *   If you are already registered, log in to your account.
3.  **Select Hospital:** Navigate to the "Book Appointment" section, select the state as **"Uttar Pradesh,"** and then select **"King George's Medical University (KGMU)"** from the list of hospitals.
4.  **Choose Department & Date:** Select the **Cardiology** department and choose your preferred date and time slot.
5.  **Enter Details:** Provide the required patient information (ensure you have your Aadhaar number ready).
6.  **Payment:** Complete the payment of the **₹50 OPD registration fee** through the provided online payment options.
7.  **Confirmation:** Once the payment is successful, download and print your **OPD appointment slip**. You must bring this slip with you when you visit the hospital.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Referral:** If you are an outside-city patient, ensure you have a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department to present upon arrival.
*   **Arrival:** Please arrive at the hospital before your scheduled time.
*   **Safety:** Do not share your personal identification details (like your full Aadhaar number) in this chat for your own security.

entries.question: If online appointment slot is full ..is there any possibility offline appointment mil jaye
entries.answer:

*   **Walk-in Process:** You can visit the KGMU OPD counter in person. You will need to bring your **Aadhaar card** and an **active mobile number** to receive an OTP for registration. After paying the ₹50 fee, you will receive a physical token or OPD slip.
*   **Capacity Constraints:** While walk-in registration is an option, it is subject to the daily patient load and department capacity. To ensure you are seen, it is highly recommended to arrive as early as possible.
*   **Counter Closing:** Please note that the Parchi/ticket counter closes strictly at **1:00 PM** (Monday–Friday) and **12:00 PM** (Saturday). 
*   **Referral Requirement:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, remember that you must carry a valid referral letter for the specific department you need to visit.

entries.question: Opd apointment
entries.answer:

### **Booking Methods**
*   **Online (ORS):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, choose your department/date/time, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
*   **Mobile App:** You can use the ABHA/Health Care App to register and follow the same booking flow.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to the hospital. You will receive an OTP, pay the ₹50 fee, and receive a physical token to collect your OPD slip.

### **Important OPD Information**
*   **Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Counter Closing:** The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referrals:** Patients visiting from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Helpline:** If you need assistance, you can call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.

**Safety Note:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the official helpline. Additionally, please avoid sharing sensitive personal details like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: Kgmu me cect karane se pahle kon si jache mangte h
entries.answer:
KGMU mein CECT (Contrast Enhanced Computed Tomography) scan karane se pehle aapko kuch zaroori jaanch (tests) karwani padti hain, jisse ye sunishchit kiya ja sake ki aapka sharir contrast dye (jo scan mein istemal hota hai) ke liye surakshit hai.

Aam taur par, CECT se pehle ye jaanch maangi jaati hain:

1. **Serum Creatinine:** Ye sabse zaroori test hai. Isse ye pata chalta hai ki aapki kidney contrast dye ko filter karne ke liye sahi se kaam kar rahi hai ya nahi.
2. **eGFR (Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate):** Ye bhi kidney function ko samajhne ke liye dekha jaata hai.

**Kuch mahatvapurn baatein:**
* **Doctor ki Salah:** Aapke doctor ya radiologist aapki medical history (jaise ki allergy, asthma, ya pehle se koi kidney ki bimari) ko dekhkar hi final jaanch likhenge.
* **OPD se Sampark:** Aap apne department ke doctor se milein, wahi aapko sahi "investigation form" denge.
* **Emergency/Safety:** Main's website ya department ke notice board par di gayi directory se apne department ke PRO ya receptionist se sampark karein agar aapko koi confuse ho.

**Suraksha Chetawani:**
Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical advice ya prescription nahi de sakta. Kripya apne ilaaj karne wale doctor se hi puchein ki aapke case mein kaun si specific jaanch ki zaroorat hai.

**Personal Data Safety:**
Apni medical report ya koi bhi vyaktigat jaankari (Aadhaar, phone number, aadi) is chat mein share na karein. Apne doctor se milte waqt hi apni purani reports dikhayein.

For the most accurate and current fee details for the Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) program for the 2026-27 session, I recommend the following:

1.  **Official Admission Portal:** Check the [Courses and Admission page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) regularly for the official information brochure for the 2026-27 academic session.
2.  **Contact the Admission Office:** You may contact the KGMU Registrar's office or the relevant department for specific fee structure queries.
    *   **Registrar Office:** 0522-2253171
    *   **Helpline:** 0522-2258880

Please note that fees at KGMU are subject to change based on university policy and government regulations. Always refer to the official prospectus released by the university for the current academic year.
